Prompt 15 is the production deployment and handoff prompt. It does not build new features. It takes everything built across Prompts 1–14 and deploys it correctly, monitors it properly, and sets up the data infrastructure that Phase 2 will need. When Prompt 15 is complete, Torgima is live, monitored, and ready for real users. The Phase 2 build sequence begins when real users start generating real execution data.
HARD LESSONS FROM PRIOR DEPLOYMENT (DO NOT REPEAT)
Special characters in database passwords silently break connection URLs. Use alphanumeric-only passwords for Supabase.
Cursor can push to feature branches while main stays behind. Always verify which branch Vercel is deploying from before assuming a deployment includes your latest work.
Package interdependencies in monorepos must compile in correct order. Verify build order in vercel.json.
Node/pnpm version alignment must be explicit via .node-version file. Vercel uses a different default than local.
Embedded platform-specific references (Replit fallbacks, development-only APIs) silently break production behavior. Grep for them before every deployment.

Phase 2 (Psychological Civilization) builds on real user execution data. These are the minimum data thresholds before Phase 2 build begins.
Minimum 50 active users who have completed at least 7 days of execution inside the system
Minimum 500 complete Primary Loop cycles (feedback → signal → condition → new task) across all users
Minimum 100 BurnoutRecord entries across users — gives Pattern Learning meaningful sample sizes
Minimum 14 days of SignalRecord history for at least 30 users — needed for meaningful trajectory analysis
Minimum 50 FailureClassification records — needed for multi-hypothesis failure detection calibration
Minimum 2 full weeks of overnight worker runs for at least 20 users — EIS needs real data to learn from
Minimum 20 completed Academy learning paths — needed to validate mastery assessment accuracy
Minimum 10 PatternRecord entries per user for at least 20 users — needed for Phase 2 behavioral intelligence
